sources.title: On the dynamics of lattice systems with unbounded on-site terms in the Hamiltonian
sources.reading_depth: Selected full-text passages in Sections 1–3; Proposition 2.1, Lemma 2.2, Theorem 3.1 proof via interaction picture and recursion, Theorem 3.2 finite-volume comparison. Not every reference or proof line audited.
sources.supports: Unbounded onsite terms require careful strong operator calculus; bounded interactions retain locality estimates and finite-volume dynamical limits.
sources.limitations: The workbench's explicit four-link branching constants and locally integrable time-varying Casimir coefficients are derived in locality.md, not quoted from this static onsite theorem. No mass-gap implication.

sources.title: Quasi-Locality Bounds for Quantum Lattice Systems. Part I. Lieb-Robinson Bounds, Quasi-Local Maps, and Spectral Flow Automorphisms
sources.authors: Bruno Nachtergaele, Robert Sims and Amanda Young
sources.type: primary mathematical research and framework paper
sources.reading_depth: Selected full-text Section 3.1–3.3 passages: Lemma 3.2, Theorems 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 3.5, chain and remainder equations 3.40–3.48, unbounded onsite construction 3.49–3.61, and finite-volume comparison 3.76. The 106-page paper was not read cover to cover.
sources.supports: Time-dependent bounded interactions, unitary resummation for a consecutive-overlap chain estimate, unbounded onsite interaction picture, and local dynamics convergence between volumes.
sources.limitations: General framework is established literature; no novelty claimed. Strong continuity differs from norm continuity on the algebra of every bounded local operator. The present coefficient and graph specialization has its own explicit proof.
